description: This file defines the RulesetParameter class in the AWS SDK, which manages parameter properties including validation, defaults, and type checks within the endpoint ruleset.

classes.name: RulesetParameter
classes.description: Represents a parameter in an endpoint ruleset, handling validation, default values, documentation, deprecation notices, and type checking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a RulesetParameter with a name and definition array, validating the type.

methods.name: getBuiltIn
methods.description: Returns the built-in property information of the parameter.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default value of the parameter.

methods.name: getRequired
methods.description: Returns whether the parameter is required.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Returns the documentation string for the parameter.

methods.name: getDeprecated
methods.description: Returns whether the parameter is deprecated.

methods.name: validateInputParam
methods.description: Validates an input parameter against its type and emits a warning if deprecated.

methods.name: isValidType
methods.description: Checks if a specified type is valid based on the type map.

methods.name: isValidInput
methods.description: Checks if an input value matches the expected type for validation.

methods.name: isStringArray
methods.description: Checks if an array is a string array (not associative).
